source.text: Chat app, from an unknown number +62 812-0000-1234

message.text: Assalamualaikum, please come to our wedding. Open the invitation here 🙏

explanation: A wedding invitation from an unknown number that comes as an app (APK), not an image or PDF, is a common scam trick. If installed, an app like this can steal data from your phone.
hints: Invitations are usually images or PDFs. Look at the file type.
